title: Where to publish
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Where could your next article appear this week?

Jose said that the author's pitch is: write a book to get authority, and you can hand it to someone in a meeting where relevant. He said it is a good way, and he commented that the author is making his plug.

Jose said: go to Google and research blog posts; they are happy to receive content all day long. If you are not writing articles on the professional network, you are being negligent, because it moved from job hunting to a content aggregator.
He said that press releases are very good through a wire service that syndicates to publications around the world, targeted to the audience and the region.
Jose asked whether the group wanted more on speaking engagements and said he would go deeper into what they covered on the last call.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write three blogs that take guest posts.
Write one article title for each.
Write one wire release you could send.
Write one event to speak at.
Write the date you will publish.

check.q: What did Jose say blogs are happy to receive?
What did Jose say a wire service does?
What did Jose say about not writing articles?

recap: Publish in blogs, on networks, through wires and on stages.
